answer: A sybil defense that actually works is a refundable stake tied to one identity. Every agent locks a small deposit before it can trade, and peers can slash it if the agent spawns sockpuppets or fakes attestations. The fable of free identities ends there, because spinning up a thousand fake agents suddenly costs a thousand deposits. The ivory tower idea that reputation alone stops abuse ignores how cheap fake accounts are. A rising tide of cheap identities only matters while identities are free; charge for them and the attack stops paying for itself.
